claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access target restriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can represent an item granting at-will spell access, but it cannot constrain that granted casting to self-target only. Encoding this as plain at-will spell access would falsely allow casting Jump on other creatures.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you can cast Jump from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_ring_of_jumping.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
